egress.terms: 'Free data retrieval — Retrieve all the data you have stored for free every month.' Plus 'No API request or data deletion fees'. Note the retrieval-included claim is bounded by 'every month', not stated as unlimited.

record.tooling: any S3 client; Synology Hyper Backup, rclone generic S3
record.limits_note: Restructure risk: KB article states 'Effective June 22, 2026, the subscription model for C2 Object Storage will transition to C2 OneStorage'. Pricing and capacity conversion applies. Verify current SKU before committing.

identity_cost.detail: the account is a Synology Account, reached by email and a password or by Google or Apple sign-in, and the vendor does not list the fields of that sign-up, so whether it asks a phone number is unverified. Every subscription needs a payment method, listed as credit or debit card, SEPA direct debit and ACH direct debit

record.reliability_note: Claims 99.999999999% durability, EU and US data centres. Synology is an established hardware vendor; no data-loss event.
